name: Hacker News
tagline: Top stories, threads & search — on demand.
author: third-party · mcp-hn

tools.name: get_stories
tools.description: Fetch Hacker News stories — top, new, ask_hn, or show_hn.

inputSchema.story_type: string — top | new | ask_hn | show_hn (optional, default top)

tools.name: get_story_info
tools.description: Fetch a story and its comment thread by id.

inputSchema.story_id: number — the HN item id. Required.

tools.name: search_stories
tools.description: Search Hacker News stories by query.

inputSchema.query: string — what to search for. Required.

tools.name: get_user_info
tools.description: Fetch a Hacker News user's profile.

inside: Search by query · look up a user
No account, no key — runs local via uvx mcp-hn
